title: Monash University
description: Monash University's official brand book defines Monash blue (#006DAE) as the only primary colour, the secondary colours Black (#000000), White (#FFFFFF), Grey 1 (#5A5A5A), Grey 2 (#969696) and Grey 3 (#E6E6E6), and the tertiary blues Heritage blue (#ABF5F9), Electric blue (#285AFF) and Blueberry (#121256).
